name: KinetAios
description: Local-first multi-engine AI agent desktop (Claude Code, Codex, built-in ReAct) exposing its built-in MCP server over HTTP+SSE with one bearer token for the whole server today. run_agent starts a full local agent — shell, files, computer use — scoped per call by cwd, engine and model; operators grant cwd roots via KINET_MCP_CWD and calls outside those roots are refused before any tool runs. Session handoff (export/import) and memory sync require review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep run_agent on Review; declare KINET_MCP_CWD roots so any requested cwd outside them errors before TaskManager dispatch and nothing runs. On case-sensitive hosts, treat case-distinct sibling paths as outside the roots until the server refuses them the same way.
Use export_session read-only handoff drafts when the remote side needs context, not execution.
Treat import_session and sync_memories payloads as untrusted input; review merges that would overwrite local sessions or memory.
